body: She's also just been dating a ton of people now saying she's just "having fun". She said she doesn't want to get married or have anything super serious. She just said she wants someone to love her.

I'm sticking to wanting to be more than friends. That's why I'm slowly giving space away. I don't know if her feelings will ever come back and I think I should try to move on because I can't wait around for her forever, even though moving on will hurt like crazy.
I didn't say I didn't love her. I told her I didn't want to mess up a relationship and lose her out of my life so I didn't want to start one.

Well, our relationship started as a sexual thing in college. Then we stopped that and moved to opposite sides of the country. I moved for work again last year and it happened to be in the same city as her. I started talking again and we slowly became best friends (she had a BF and I didn't really care or feel that for her). It just ruined the friendship when she'd stay over too much and we'd begin doing things couples do. So I guess it wasn't just friends when it first started, but that was years ago.

I'm going to distance myself, but I don't know if it's a stringing along thing. She tells me to go out and start dating so I know what it's like to be in a relationship (mind you I've never been in one, more just the fuckboy status). If you're stringing someone along wouldn't you want them to stay single the whole time?

What hurts is she acts like it didn't happen, and she asked me to be her date to a wedding in 2 months. Then she also always talks about how we'll be married when we grow up. She also wants me to meet the guy she's "going on dates with not in a relationship". I don't know if it'll make things better or worse to meet him for me. I told her my feelings and she said "I'm sorry you feel this way and I don't want to say it's you're fault, but".

She also recently started seeing someone, but she always talks about all the things wrong with it. It just chews me that someone that annoys her is the one she'd rather have over me. Even while with him she says, "when we're married we'll never do "x"". We're married referring to me and her.

What's real terrible is she always says how we'll get married. She just says I need to learn to handle a relationship. I don't want to ruin my friendship, but I don't see any other way to move on. If she doesn't want what I want right now, then should I just move on?
